g.text: Purple squares: GPU, L40, 4 host workers
Stars: fastest median inside the 10% byte allowance
Each backend has its own input/session group
include the earlier phases and excluded cases.
Microscopy streaming: throughput and measured shard-write bytes
Preloaded cyclic replay; source I/O/decoding excluded, final drain included. Shard-write bytes are a measured proxy,
not a final stored-file census. Stars select whole configurations (chunk shape, codec and block); labels give raw chunk KiB.
CPU/GPU are separate machines and resource budgets. All source summary IDs are retained in figure-data.csv.
